_story.title: Your TV Remembers Without Batteries
_story.hook: Did You Know Your TV Remote Remembers You Without Batteries? 🤯
_story.headline: The Invisible 'Memory' in Your Simple Remote Control
_story.fact_summary: That simple TV remote you use every day has a tiny, 'smart' chip inside that remembers its last button press even when the batteries are out! This memory is incredibly basic, just storing a few bits of information, but it's enough to keep track of what it was doing. It's like a tiny notepad that never gets erased, even without power.
